audience: American viewers (US attention, not USA-only topics)
note: English-only ChronoShorts-style hooks. Mix US history, world history Americans binge, biographies, did-you-know facts. Zero paid APIs.

scenarios.name: Failed Before Fame
scenarios.angle: Dismissed as a failure — then history flips.
scenarios.hook_style: Open at rock bottom before the reveal.

scenarios.name: Traitor Twist
scenarios.angle: Praised as a hero — then the knife turns.
scenarios.hook_style: Start as praise, flip to betrayal.

scenarios.name: Refused Power
scenarios.angle: Could have taken a crown — walked away.
scenarios.hook_style: Contrast conquerors who seize power with the one who said no.

scenarios.name: Overlooked Hero
scenarios.angle: Textbooks skim them — their act changed everything.
scenarios.hook_style: You know the famous name. Not the person who made it possible.

scenarios.name: Ironic Ending
scenarios.angle: Plan, prophecy, or ambition ends opposite of intended.
scenarios.hook_style: State the goal — land the historical punchline.

scenarios.name: Ironic Death
scenarios.angle: How they died is the twist America can't stop sharing.
scenarios.hook_style: Lead with the absurd or poetic death detail.

scenarios.name: One Decision
scenarios.angle: A single choice rewrites the map or the century.
scenarios.hook_style: Zoom into one vote, order, signature, or second.

scenarios.name: Underdog Victory
scenarios.hook_style: Stack impossible odds in the first two lines.

scenarios.name: Did You Know
scenarios.angle: One surprising fact Americans share — punchy curiosity.
scenarios.hook_style: Open with the disbelief CLAIM (optional 'Did you know' opener; claim is mandatory).
example_topics: Cleopatra closer to iPhone than pyramids

scenarios.name: Empire Twist
scenarios.angle: An empire's peak hides the seed of its collapse — or a forgotten flex.
scenarios.hook_style: Start with power porn, end with the crack in the marble.

scenarios.name: Cold War Fact
scenarios.angle: Nuclear-age absurdity, spies, and near-misses US audiences love.
scenarios.hook_style: One button / one spy / one near-apocalypse.

scenarios.name: WWII Hook
scenarios.angle: World War II story with a US-audience cold open.
scenarios.hook_style: Lead with the detail Hollywood skipped.
